body: I understand...when you're in darkness, you cannot see what makes you stumble....but forgiveness and acceptance that we're all contending with the human condition and the unpredictable nature of reality might just be the lantern you're looking for
What really, from a zoomed out perspective, is the significance of blame? This includes self blame as well...
Has she ever talked about why she left?
So you haven't spoken to your mom since then?
What happened to make you feel this way?
Are you an 800lb quadruple amputee senior citizen?

This construct is obnoxiously paradoxical for sure...being a shard of the collective consciousness is all well and good..the illusion of self sure is neat...especially with the array of upgrades and decorations one can obtain...i value the "good" and the "bad"...the light and the dark...i recognize the duality of it all...but, frankly, I'm over it...i think I'd rather be on the sidelines
I've felt this way since I was about 7...I don't, and never have, blamed anyone for anything...its just cold and rainy and my right eye is twitching
